ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has a horizontal Re(s) axis and a vertical Im(s) axis. The Nyquist contour mainly surrounds the right half-plane, and near the imaginary axis it passes around the region near the origin through a small loop to the left; the origin is inside this small neighborhood. The point s=-1 is marked on the negative direction of the real axis; it is farther left than this small loop and is not surrounded by the contour. Reasoning: The open-loop transfer function is G(s)=1/[s(s+1)], and the open-loop poles are at s=0 and s=-1. From the contour shown, s=0 is contained within the contour, while s=-1 is not within the contour, so P=1. The closed-loop characteristic equation is 1+G(s)=0, namely 1+1/[s(s+1)]=0, giving s(s+1)+1=0, which is s^2+s+1=0. Its roots are s=-1/2 ± j√3/2, with real part -1/2, and are not in the right half-plane plus the small neighborhood of the origin enclosed by this contour, so Z=0. From the Nyquist relation, the magnitude of the number of encirclements about the point -1+j0 is |Z-P|=|0-1|=1. Therefore N=1.

Count open-loop poles inside the contour: s=0 is included because of the small neighborhood around the origin; s=-1 is not included because it is visibly to the left of the small indentation. method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the upward arrows on the imaginary-axis portions, the small leftward indentation around s=0, and the large closing arc in the right half-plane. From the text, take G(s)=1/[s(s+1)]. Map the imaginary-axis portions using s=jω: G(jω)=-1/(1+ω^2)-j/[ω(1+ω^2)], so the upper and lower branches lie to the left of the imaginary axis in the G-plane and approach the real value -1 as ω→0 with infinite imaginary excursions. 图像描述：图中是 s 平面的 Nyquist 围线，横轴标为 Re(s)，纵轴标为 Im(s)。围线沿虚轴的上下两段都有向上的箭头；在原点附近，围线向左半平面作一个小的左向凹入/绕避，包住原点附近的一小块左半平面区域；右侧有一个大的半圆闭合弧，箭头沿右半平面大弧从上向下。图中还在负实轴上标出了 -1 点。

推理：给定 G(s)=1/[s(s+1)]。在虚轴段令 s=jω，则 G(jω)=1/[jω(1+jω)]=-1/(1+ω^2)-j/[ω(1+ω^2)]。因此虚轴上、下两段映射到 G 平面时都位于虚轴左侧；当 ω→0^+ 时，实部趋于 -1，虚部趋于 -∞；当 ω→0^- 时，实部趋于 -1，虚部趋于 +∞。原点附近的小凹入在左半平面，且在该小圆弧附近 G(s)≈1/s，所以它的映射是一个很大的圆弧，用来连接上述趋向正、负无穷的两条分支，并使 Nyquist 曲线绕过点 (-1+j0)。右半平面的大闭合弧对应 |s| 很大，G(s)≈1/s^2，映射靠近原点，不会额外增加对 (-1+j0) 的环绕。综合这些部分，Nyquist 图对点 (-1+j0) 恰好环绕一次，所以 N=1。
